remarks: Nestled within the highly sought-after Delafield Island Association, 46 Sunswyck Road is a distinguished brick estate set on 1.3 acres of impeccably landscaped grounds. Manicured lawns, a variety of plants, and mature trees create a serene, park-like setting that enhances the home's timeless architecture.  This stately 5-bedroom residence blends classic elegance with modern upgrades. Inside, a newly installed HVAC system ensures year-round comfort, while outside, expansive spaces invite relaxation and entertaining.   Thoughtful details-including an electric vehicle charging station inside of the two door garage-add convenience for today's lifestyle.  A rare opportunity to own a true estate property in one of Darien's most coveted private associations, just moments from the water and minutes to town.
